                new_st, extra = simulate_move(state, m)
                children.append((m, new_st, extra))
            
            def child_priority(item):
                m, new_st, extra = item
                if new_st is None:
                    return extra
                elif extra:
                    return evaluate(new_st)
                else:
                    return -evaluate(new_st)
            children.sort(reverse=True, key=child_priority)
            
            best_val = -float('inf')
            current_best = children[0][0]
            alpha = -float('inf')
            beta = float('inf')
            for m, new_st, extra in children:
                if new_st is None:
                    val = extra
                else:
                    if extra:
                        val = negamax(new_st, depth-1, alpha, beta)
                    else:
                        val = -negamax(new_st, depth-1, -beta, -alpha)
                if val > best_val:
                    best_val = val
                    current_best = m
                alpha = max(alpha, val)
                # time check inside loop? already in negamax, but we can also check here
                if time.time() - start_time > TIME_LIMIT:
                    raise TimeoutError()
            best_move = current_best
    except TimeoutError:
        pass
    
    return best_move
